preconditions.description: The number of bases n and the number of bases that have to remain k are both within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all( -10^9 <= x, y <= 10^9 for x, y in bases )
preconditions.description: The coordinates of each base are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: one base is at the origin (0, 0)
preconditions.description: One of the bases is located at the origin.

postconditions.description: The output is a floating-point number representing the maximal possible sum of distances between all pairs of some k from given bases.
The output is accurate to within a relative or absolute error of less than 10^-6.
